name: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric

intro: As a candidate for this exam, you should have subject matter expertise in designing, creating, and deploying enterprise-scale data analytics solutions.
You implement analytics best practices in Fabric, including version control and deployment.
